newsitem.title: USA: Targeted Genetics says trial shows safety.
newsitem.headline: Targeted Genetics says trial shows safety.

text.p: Targeted Genetics Corp said preliminary results of two Phase I clinical trials of its AAV-CFTR gene product in patients with cystic fibrosis demonstrated safety, efficient gene transfer and long-term gene persistence.
The results of the Phase I trials will be presented by investigators at the 10th Annual North American Cystic Fibrosis Conference Friday and Sunday in Orlando, Fla.

Cystic fibrosis is an inherited disease characterized by thick mucus secretions that clog patients' airways and digestive system and lead to serious lung infections and ultimately death in young adults.
